'''Cebz''' was a dominant [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Marit]] who participated in the [[Battle of Gaftikar]]. Before the battle, she led [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] and [[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]] to [[Eyat]] City for reconnaissance of the [[City/Legends|city]].
